t: Listen, everyone. Our school trip is on Friday. We're going to the zoo. The bus leaves at nine o'clock. Please bring a packed lunch and a hat, because it's going to be sunny. The trip costs six pounds. We'll be back at school at three.
lines.plain: Listen, everyone. Our school trip is on Friday. We're going to the zoo. The bus leaves at nine o'clock. Please bring a packed lunch and a hat, because it's going to be sunny. The trip costs six pounds. We'll be back at school at three.
lines.kana: Listen, everyone. Our school trip is on Friday. We're going to the zoo. The bus leaves at nine o'clock. Please bring a packed lunch and a hat, because it's going to be sunny. The trip costs six pounds. We'll be back at school at three.
lines.zh: 大家聽好。我們的校外教學在星期五，要去動物園。巴士九點出發。請帶便當和帽子，因為會很晴朗。費用六英鎊。我們三點回到學校。
lines.en: Listen, everyone. Our school trip is on Friday. We're going to the zoo. The bus leaves at nine o'clock. Please bring a packed lunch and a hat, because it's going to be sunny. The trip costs six pounds. We'll be back at school at three.
lines.zh-Hans: 大家听好。我们的校外教学在星期五，要去动物园。巴士九点出发。请带便当和帽子，因为会很晴朗。费用六英镑。我们三点回到学校。
lines.ja: 皆さん、聞いてください。私たちの遠足は金曜日です。動物園に行きます。バスは9時に出発します。晴れるので、お弁当と帽子を持ってきてください。費用は6ポンドです。3時に学校に戻ります。
lines.ko: 여러분, 주목하세요. 우리 학교 소풍은 금요일이에요. 동물원에 갈 거예요. 버스는 9시에 출발해요. 날씨가 맑을 예정이니 도시락과 모자를 가져오세요. 비용은 6파운드예요. 3시에 학교로 돌아올 거예요.
lines.ru: Слушайте все. Наша школьная экскурсия в пятницу. Мы едем в зоопарк. Автобус отправляется в девять часов. Пожалуйста, возьмите с собой упакованный обед и кепку, потому что будет солнечно. Поездка стоит шесть фунтов. Мы вернемся в школу в три.
lines.fr: Écoutez, tout le monde. Notre sortie scolaire a lieu vendredi. Nous allons au zoo. Le bus part à neuf heures. Veuillez apporter un panier-repas et une casquette, car il va faire beau. La sortie coûte six livres. Nous serons de retour à l'école à trois heures.
lines.es: Escuchen todos. Nuestra excursión escolar es el viernes. Vamos al zoológico. El autobús sale a las nueve en punto. Por favor, traigan un almuerzo preparado y una gorra, porque va a estar soleado. La excursión cuesta seis libras. Estaremos de regreso en la escuela a las tres.
lines.de: Hört zu, alle zusammen. Unser Schulausflug ist am Freitag. Wir fahren in den Zoo. Der Bus fährt um neun Uhr ab. Bitte bringt ein Lunchpaket und eine Kopfbedeckung mit, da es sonnig wird. Der Ausflug kostet sechs Pfund. Wir sind um drei Uhr wieder zurück in der Schule.

t: You will hear a man talking about a new swimming club.

lines.zh-Hans: 你会听到一位男士介绍新的游泳社。

t: Hello, everyone. There's a new swimming club for children at the sports centre. It's on Tuesday afternoons, from four to five. It's for children from six to ten years old. Please bring a towel. The club costs three pounds each week. Our teacher's name is Mr Green.

lines.kana: Hello, everyone. There's a new swimming club for children at the sports centre. It's on Tuesday afternoons, from four to five. It's for children from six to ten years old. Please bring a towel. The club costs three pounds each week. Our teacher's name is Mr Green.
lines.zh: 大家好。運動中心有一個新的兒童游泳社，在星期二下午四點到五點，給六到十歲的孩子參加。請帶毛巾。每週三英鎊。老師是格林先生。
lines.en: Hello, everyone. There's a new swimming club for children at the sports centre. It's on Tuesday afternoons, from four to five. It's for children from six to ten years old. Please bring a towel. The club costs three pounds each week. Our teacher's name is Mr Green.
lines.zh-Hans: 大家好。运动中心有一个新的儿童游泳社，在星期二下午四点到五点，给六到十岁的孩子参加。请带毛巾。每周三英镑。老师是格林先生。

lines.en: I love books. Or you can make me a card!
lines.zh-Hans: 我喜欢书。或者你可以做张卡片给我！

lines.zh: 好。我妹妹也能來嗎？她八歲。

lines.zh-Hans: 好。我妹妹也能来吗？她八岁。
